gate.rationale: V2-WS1.1b scored 90.54 corrected; +0.5 is the smallest change worth carrying forward.

notes: Implemented in yolost/dfl.py with patches 0006 and 0007. reg_max 0 keeps the original head bit-identical and a test asserts the distribution term is exactly zero there. 24 tests cover the arithmetic, the wiring, and that the training decode and the evaluator decode produce identical boxes.
one_variable: Dense box head parameterisation: direct centre/size regression -> distribution over LTRB distances, reg_max 16, lambda_dfl 1.5. Backbone, resolution, learning rate, schedule, batch, seed and AMP dtype unchanged from V2-WS1.1b.
purpose: Replace direct box regression with distribution regression in the dense head. Each side of the box becomes a categorical distribution over 17 discrete distances from the anchor, decoded by expectation, instead of a sigmoid centre offset and an exponentiated size. This is the parameterisation YOLOv8, YOLO11 and YOWOFormer use; YOWOFormer reaches 92.48 frame mAP with the same VideoMAE-Large weights this lineage tops out at 90.54 with. D-FINE reports the family as worth up to +5.3 AP across DETRs, concentrated at high IoU.
